title: This ER Doctor Became a Hospital’s First Clinical AI Engineer

claims.claim: Boston Children's Hospital posted a job listing for a prompt engineer in 2023, and Dinesh Rai applied for it.

evidence.quote: When Boston Children’s Hospital posted a job listing for a prompt engineer in 2023, Dinesh Rai decided to apply.

claims.claim: Boston Children's Hospital brought Dinesh Rai on board in August 2023.

evidence.quote: Boston Children’s brought him on board in August 2023.

claims.claim: John Brownstein is the chief innovation officer at Boston Children's.

evidence.quote: says John Brownstein, chief innovation officer at Boston Children’s.
“Knowing how to prompt AI properly was going to be the job function of the future,” says John Brownstein, chief innovation officer at Boston Children’s.

claims.claim: Dinesh Rai earned a Bachelor's degree in supply-chain management and marketing sciences from Rutgers Business School and a Doctor of Medicine from Albert Einstein College of Medicine.

evidence.quote: Bachelor’s degree in supply-chain management and marketing sciences, Rutgers Business School; Doctor of Medicine, Albert Einstein College of Medicine

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in supply-chain management and marketing sciences, Rutgers Business School; Doctor of Medicine, Albert Einstein College of Medicine

claims.claim: Dinesh Rai began teaching himself to code in 2014, the same year he entered medical school.

evidence.quote: Rai originally studied business as an undergraduate and began teaching himself to code in 2014 (the same year he entered medical school)

claims.claim: In 2022, Dinesh Rai took a job at Pieces, a health care AI company.

evidence.quote: In 2022, Rai took a job at Pieces, a health care AI company, where he led work to bring LLM-based medical summarization into clinical use.

claims.claim: Dinesh Rai stated that he has reactivated his medical license and hopes to return to clinical practice in some capacity within the next year.

evidence.quote: He has since reactivated his medical license and hopes to return to clinical practice in some capacity within the next year.

claims.claim: Dinesh Rai currently works at Boston Children's Hospital as a clinical AI engineer.

evidence.quote: For Rai, that has meant embracing a job broader than the role that brought him to Boston. “I’m more like a clinical AI engineer now,” he says.
Three years later, Rai still works there.
